title: Add audit logging and rate limiting to SourceLinksController
description:
P1 finding (P1-014). SourceLinksController.Open endpoint executes server-side shell operations (Process.Start via VarResolver) with no rate limiting, no audit logging, and no confirmation dialog. Any authorized user can trigger repeated server-side process launches.
